content.rendered:
It amazes me that Bruce has only covered this once, at Light of Day 2014–this would be an instant highlight at an E Street Band concert.

For now, though, we’ll have to be content with Bruce and Jesse Malin teaming up for The Ramones’ “Do You Remember Rock’n’Roll Radio?”

Here’s the original for good measure–because there’s no such thing as too much airplay for the classics.

Recorded in 1979 and released the following year, this was Joey Ramone’s paean to the classic sound of rock and roll and his lament at how modern rock had become so commercialized.

Ironic (and prescient) at the time, it plays sincerely today, when rock and roll is virtually gone from all but the oldies stations.

Do You Remember Rock ‘n’ Roll Radio
First performed: January 18, 2014 (Asbury Park, NJ)
Last performed: January 18, 2014 (Asbury Park, NJ)

© March 7, 2018 / June 3, 2026

excerpt.rendered: A one-time-only cover of a Ramones classic.

jetpack-related-posts.title: New York Comeback
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Few artists have had to stage a comeback like Lucinda Williams. In January 2020, a tornado ripped through her home. We all know what happened in the weeks and months that followed. And if losing a home and a navigating a global pandemic wasn't enough, in November of that year…

jetpack-related-posts.title: She Don’t Love Me Now
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: A return to form for Bruce as a cover artist and a fitting tribute for an artist we've featured here may times before.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Jesse Malin: Janey, Don’t You Lose Heart
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Jesse Malin and friends gave us a lovely cover of one Bruce's lighter tracks, from Light of Day 2017.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me, Town Bike: Radio Nowhere
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: C’mon, admit it: who among us hasn’t wondered what it would sound like if The Ramones and The Go-Gos teamed up to cover “Radio Nowhere?”

jetpack-related-posts.title: December 8
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: On this date: Bruce announces the reunion of the E Street Band! Plus: Watch Bruce improv a new "song" when nature calls during a show, catch two holiday shows, and more.

jetpack-related-posts.title: December 7
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: It's a date for tributes, as Bruce salutes Harry Chapin, Bob Dylan, and Sting. Plus: two holiday shows, Clarence's last E Street appearance, Bruce plays Sing Sing Prison and more--all on this very, very packed date.
